1.content:
## VMware Problem Dashboard — Host & Hypervisor Resource Saturation
---
Problems are traced **down to the affected host and the ESXi hypervisor it runs on**, then filtered to the three signals most often caused by VMware over-provisioning: **Slow Disk**, **CPU Saturation** and **Memory Saturation**.

Use the **Resource issue**, **Hypervisor type** and **Status** filters at the top. `Hypervisor Type = VMWARE` is OneAgent's OS-level detection; `Hypervisor (ESXi)` is the actual ESXi host from the `runs_on` relationship (populated when vCenter/ESXi monitoring is enabled).

2.title: Resource problems (total)
2.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter matchesValue(affected_entity_types, "dt.entity.host")
| expand affected_entity_ids
| filter startsWith(affected_entity_ids, "HOST-")
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd hypervisorType
  ], sourceField:affected_entity_ids, lookupField:id, prefix:"host."
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd hvArr = runs_on[dt.entity.hypervisor]
    | expand hvArr
    | lookup [fetch dt.entity.hypervisor], sourceField:hvArr, lookupField:id, fields:{hvName = entity.name}
    | summarize hypervisorName = takeFirst(hvName), by:{id}
  ], sourceField:affected_entity_ids, lookupField:id, prefix:"hv." 
// --- Hypervisor filter (host-row level) ---
| filter $Hypervisor == "ALL" or `host.hypervisorType` == $Hypervisor
// --- Collapse problem events into one row per problem ---
| summarize {startTime = takeFirst(event.start),
            endTime = takeFirst(event.end),
            problemClosedDuration = takeFirst(resolved_problem_duration),
            status = takeFirst(event.status),
            `event.name` = takeFirst(event.name),
            severityLevel = takeFirst(event.category),
            isDup = takeFirst(dt.davis.is_duplicate),
            hosts = collectDistinct(`host.entity.name`),
            hypervisorTypes = collectDistinct(`host.hypervisorType`),
            hypervisors = collectDistinct(`hv.hypervisorName`),
            vmwareHostCount = countIf(`host.hypervisorType` == "VMWARE"),
            `event.id` = takeFirst(event.id)},
            by:{display_id}
| filter isDup == false
| fieldsAdd status = if((status == "ACTIVE"),"OPEN", else:if((status == "CLOSED"),"CLOSED"))
| fieldsAdd resourceIssue = if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"disk"),"Slow Disk",
                          else:if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"cpu"),"CPU Saturation",
                          else:if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"memory"),"Memory Saturation",
                          else:"Other")))
// --- Status filter ---
| filter $Status == "ALL" or status == $Status
| filter resourceIssue != "Other"
| filter $ResourceIssue == "ALL" or resourceIssue == $ResourceIssue
| summarize Total = count()

8.title: Problems → Host → Hypervisor (VMware resource issues)
8.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter matchesValue(affected_entity_types, "dt.entity.host")
| expand affected_entity_ids
| filter startsWith(affected_entity_ids, "HOST-")
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd hypervisorType
  ], sourceField:affected_entity_ids, lookupField:id, prefix:"host."
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd hvArr = runs_on[dt.entity.hypervisor]
    | expand hvArr
    | lookup [fetch dt.entity.hypervisor], sourceField:hvArr, lookupField:id, fields:{hvName = entity.name}
    | summarize hypervisorName = takeFirst(hvName), by:{id}
  ], sourceField:affected_entity_ids, lookupField:id, prefix:"hv." 
// --- Hypervisor filter (host-row level) ---
| filter $Hypervisor == "ALL" or `host.hypervisorType` == $Hypervisor
// --- Collapse problem events into one row per problem ---
| summarize {startTime = takeFirst(event.start),
            endTime = takeFirst(event.end),
            problemClosedDuration = takeFirst(resolved_problem_duration),
            status = takeFirst(event.status),
            `event.name` = takeFirst(event.name),
            severityLevel = takeFirst(event.category),
            isDup = takeFirst(dt.davis.is_duplicate),
            hosts = collectDistinct(`host.entity.name`),
            hypervisorTypes = collectDistinct(`host.hypervisorType`),
            hypervisors = collectDistinct(`hv.hypervisorName`),
            vmwareHostCount = countIf(`host.hypervisorType` == "VMWARE"),
            `event.id` = takeFirst(event.id)},
            by:{display_id}
| filter isDup == false
| fieldsAdd status = if((status == "ACTIVE"),"OPEN", else:if((status == "CLOSED"),"CLOSED"))
| fieldsAdd resourceIssue = if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"disk"),"Slow Disk",
                          else:if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"cpu"),"CPU Saturation",
                          else:if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"memory"),"Memory Saturation",
                          else:"Other")))
// --- Status filter ---
| filter $Status == "ALL" or status == $Status
| filter resourceIssue != "Other"
| filter $ResourceIssue == "ALL" or resourceIssue == $ResourceIssue
| fieldsAdd `On VMware` = if(vmwareHostCount > 0, "✅ VMware", else:"—")
| fieldsAdd currentTime = toTimestamp(now())
| fields Status = if((status == "OPEN"),"🔴 OPEN", else:if((status == "CLOSED"),"🟢 CLOSED")),
         Problem = concat(display_id," — ",`event.name`),
         `Resource Issue` = resourceIssue,
         `On VMware`,
         `Affected Host(s)` = hosts,
         `Hypervisor Type` = hypervisorTypes,
         `Hypervisor (ESXi)` = hypervisors,
         StartTime = startTime,
         `Duration (min)` = if((status == "CLOSED"), problemClosedDuration/60000000000,
                            else:if((status == "OPEN"), toLong(currentTime-startTime)/60000000000)),
         `event.id`
| sort StartTime, direction:"descending"
| sort Status, direction:"ascending"

10.title: Top affected hosts (VMs)
10.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter matchesValue(affected_entity_types, "dt.entity.host")
| filter dt.davis.is_duplicate == false
| expand affected_entity_ids
| filter startsWith(affected_entity_ids, "HOST-")
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd hypervisorType
  ], sourceField:affected_entity_ids, lookupField:id, prefix:"host."
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd hvArr = runs_on[dt.entity.hypervisor]
    | expand hvArr
    | lookup [fetch dt.entity.hypervisor], sourceField:hvArr, lookupField:id, fields:{hvName = entity.name}
    | summarize hypervisorName = takeFirst(hvName), by:{id}
  ], sourceField:affected_entity_ids, lookupField:id, prefix:"hv." 
| filter $Hypervisor == "ALL" or `host.hypervisorType` == $Hypervisor
| fieldsAdd status = if((event.status == "ACTIVE"),"OPEN", else:if((event.status == "CLOSED"),"CLOSED"))
| fieldsAdd resourceIssue = if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"disk"),"Slow Disk",
                          else:if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"cpu"),"CPU Saturation",
                          else:if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"memory"),"Memory Saturation",
                          else:"Other")))
| filter resourceIssue != "Other"
| filter $Status == "ALL" or status == $Status
| filter $ResourceIssue == "ALL" or resourceIssue == $ResourceIssue
| dedup {display_id, affected_entity_ids}
| summarize Problems = count(),
            VMware = if(countIf(`host.hypervisorType` == "VMWARE") > 0, "VMware", else:"Other"),
            by:{Host = `host.entity.name`}
| sort Problems, direction:"descending"
| limit 15

11.title: VM resource problems per ESXi hypervisor

12.title: Resource problems over time (by type)
12.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter matchesValue(affected_entity_types, "dt.entity.host")
| filter dt.davis.is_duplicate == false
| fieldsAdd resourceIssue = if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"disk"),"Slow Disk",
                          else:if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"cpu"),"CPU Saturation",
                          else:if(contains(lower(`event.name`),"memory"),"Memory Saturation",
                          else:"Other")))
| filter resourceIssue != "Other"
| filter $ResourceIssue == "ALL" or resourceIssue == $ResourceIssue
| makeTimeseries Problems = count(),
                 spread: timeframe(from: event.start, to: coalesce(event.end, now())),
                 by:{resourceIssue}, interval:6h
| sort resourceIssue asc

13.content:
### How VMware hosts are identified
- **`Hypervisor Type`** comes from the host attribute `hypervisorType` on `dt.entity.host` (values such as `VMWARE`, `HYPER_V`, `KVM`, `XEN`). The **On VMware** column flags any problem whose affected host reports `VMWARE`.
- **`Hypervisor (ESXi)`** is resolved via the `runs_on[dt.entity.hypervisor]` relationship — the specific ESXi host the VM sits on. A high count in **"VM resource problems per ESXi hypervisor"** is your strongest over-provisioning signal (many noisy VMs sharing one host).
- Resource buckets are keyword-matched on the Davis problem title (`disk` → Slow Disk, `cpu` → CPU Saturation, `memory` → Memory Saturation). Adjust the keywords in the `resourceIssue` classifier if your tenant uses custom problem titles.
